title: Concept: Dynamic code evaluation via Code.eval_string (elixir) — review required
description: In elixir, Code.eval_string turns a string into running code. Evaluation sinks collapse the data/code boundary, so any untrusted bytes in the string become an injection primitive. The elixir-specific remedy is data-only handling via pattern matching or Config-free data flow.
applicability: elixir codebases that build code or expressions from strings via Code.eval_string; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution in the application process when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because evaluation sinks rarely constrain what the injected code can do.
